import torch.nn as nn

LOOKBACK = ckpt['lookback']
HIDDEN = ckpt['hidden_size']
LAYERS = ckpt['num_layers']
mean = ckpt['mean']
scale = ckpt['scale']
last_window = ckpt['last_window'].clone().to(torch.float32)

class LSTMModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, num_layers):
        super().__init__()
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(input_size=1, hidden_size=hidden_size, num_layers=num_layers, batch_first=True)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1)
    def forward(self, x):
        out, _ = self.lstm(x)
        return self.fc(out[:, -1, :])

model = LSTMModel(HIDDEN, LAYERS)
model.load_state_dict(ckpt['state_dict'])
model.eval()

forecast_dates = pd.date_range('2023-06-01', '2023-07-19', freq='D')
window = last_window.clone()
preds_scaled = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for _ in range(len(forecast_dates)):
        inp = window.view(1, LOOKBACK, 1)
        out = model(inp).item()
        preds_scaled.append(out)
        window = torch.cat([window[1:], torch.tensor([out], dtype=torch.float32)])
